caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure of a woman on a plain off-white background. She is dressed in a long, light-colored gown that reaches the floor, with a closely fitted bodice and wide, puffed sleeves that gather at the wrists. The skirt of the dress is full and flows straight down from the waist. The woman’s skin is lightly shaded, and her facial features are minimal, with small, dark eyes, a small nose, and pink lips. She wears a large, round hat atop her head, which is colored in shades of brown and reddish-brown, and it appears to have texture, resembling straw. Her hair is styled close to the head and visible beneath the hat, with a purple tint. There are no other objects or details in the composition; the focus remains solely on the figure.
title: Doll
